grade.first_issue: None. The proof contains no decisive defect, so none of Rules A–F imposes a cap.
grade.summary: The submission correctly determines all solutions as f(x)=x+c with c≥0. It verifies these functions, derives nonnegativity and forward-orbit invariance of g(x)=f(x)-x, proves that all positive values of g coincide, and excludes coexistence of the values 0 and c using relative openness and connectedness. The interval-containment statements are naturally understood relative to the domain (0,∞).
strengths: The substitution x=f(y) correctly yields the affine formula for every forward orbit and hence g≥0.
The limiting comparison of two forward orbits correctly proves equality of any two positive values of g.
The mixed-value case is rigorously excluded by showing both level sets are relatively open in the connected domain.
The converse is correctly verified by the standard RMS–AM–GM inequalities.
